text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen――The victor of the battle 
between the strongest sisters was Biwa 
Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To Narita Brian, who praised her older 
sister's strength, Biwa Hayahide posed a 
single question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Was I able to become an older sister 
you can be proud of?" To Biwa Hayahide's 
question, Narita Brian――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You've been my proud big sister for as 
long as I can remember," she replies. On 
this day, the "Winning Formula" brought 
the victory she truly desired.
